name: Maureen Roulette
original_name: モーリン・ローレット
source:
Carmine's childhood friend and a maid, who has served Carmine's family for generations. She is member of Copeland Wyvern Royal Academy's 23rd graduating class. Despite her timid appearance, she has a strong heart beneath her exterior, and there are times when she speaks in a firm manner to Carmine.
Maureen has a straight-laced and cowardly personality, but that all changes when she drinks alcohol. She also has a habit of twirling her hair with her finger.

[From Frontwing's [url=https://www.facebook.com/FrontwingINT/]official Facebook page[/url]]
